sentences.en: The construction company bid for the earthwork project.
sentences.zh: 这家建筑公司投标承揽了这个土方工程。

sentences.en: Earthwork is a crucial part of landscape gardening.
sentences.zh: 土方是景观园艺的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: They had to remove the old earthworks before building the new road.
sentences.zh: 他们必须先拆除旧的路基，然后才能修建新的道路。
